# Options Megastore

> A comprehensive electronics retailer offering laptops, desktops, gaming PCs, and computer accessories with competitive pricing across Lebanon.

Options Megastore specializes in computer hardware and peripherals from leading brands including Apple, ASUS, Acer, AMD, and numerous accessory manufacturers. The site serves as a one-stop shop for consumers seeking gaming computers, professional workstations, and computing accessories in Lebanon.
